name: dexcel
description: Dexcel — Enterprise Spreadsheet Intelligence & Quantitative Analytics Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); ['index.html','maker.html','info.html','tools.html'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f); }); fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f => f.endsWith('.xlsx')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f)); console.log('Multi-page site built in public/');"
